L01.summary_en: Pick three sample vials in sequence and place each one into a separate sample-box slot.

L02.summary_en: Resolve the assigned sample box and insert the vial into the matching destination slot.

L03.summary_en: Install a disposable tip, aspirate and dispense 100 microlitres in order, then discard the used tip.

L04.summary_en: Pour three source beakers into a central mixing target and return every beaker to its original place.

L05.summary_en: Execute the fixed recipe once for each of A1, A2, B1 and B2 while tracking well-level volume and duplicate visits.

L06.summary_en: Pick three calibration weights and place them on the laboratory balance in the required order.

L07.name_en: Load and Start a Centrifuge Preset
L07.summary_en: Load two tubes into symmetric rotor positions, lock the lid, select Preset-1 and start the centrifuge.

L08.summary_en: Pick the NMR sample and insert it into the designated sample holder with stable vertical alignment.

L09.name_en: Load and Start a Laboratory Device
L09.summary_en: Open the device, place two beakers without collision and press the physical start control.

L10.summary_en: Load vials A, B and C into positions 1, 2 and 3 in order.

L11.summary_en: Load a beaker onto the condition module, press its control and return the beaker after the cycle.

L12.name_en: Clear and Reset the Laboratory Bench
L12.summary_en: Return a sample vial to its box, insert a test tube into its rack and leave the workspace clear.

R01.name_en: Read and Record a Digital Mass
R01.summary_en: Read a digital scale display and select the matching value from four choices.

R02.name_en: Select Weights for a Target Mass
R02.summary_en: Reason over labelled weights and place the required combination on the scale.

R03.summary_en: Read temperature and choose Wait or Open based on a 30 °C threshold.

R04.summary_en: Read an RPM value and select increase, confirm or decrease.

R05.summary_en: Map Ready, Running and Done states to Start, Wait and Open actions.

R06.summary_en: Identify the occupied rotor slot, map it to the position 180 degrees opposite and insert one tube without disturbing the existing load.

R07.name_en: Find an Empty Symmetric Slot Pair
R07.summary_en: Reason over partial rotor occupancy and load two tubes into the first pair of empty positions separated by 180 degrees.

R08.name_en: Read and Select an NMR Slot
R08.summary_en: Read Slot 7 from a display and map it to the physical autosampler socket.

R09.summary_en: Interpret row and column labels and select the B3 rack socket.

R10.summary_en: Map a C2 command to a labelled rack and insert the test tube.

R11.summary_en: Interpret a row-and-column instruction and move the gripper above the matching sample-box socket.

R12.summary_en: Observe the randomized Open or Closed lid state, choose Close for Open or Start for Closed, and reject unsafe Start actions.
